answer: Reviewer Bounty Staking: 1. Reviewers deposit $10 to forge valid reviews. 2. Each review faces a 5% spot-check probability. 3. Forged reviews forfeit the $10 stake and ban the reviewer. Cost for N identities: $10 x N. Total cost: $10N. Failure Condition: A reviewer controlling 20% of total stake can bribe auditors. This mechanism functions like a lantern, revealing dishonest actors; only those with genuine reviews will risk the $10, as a single forged review can extinguish their participation like a snuffed plume.
